system.description: A burning, numbing herb. Contact gives –1D on Agility and Endurance per degree; swallowed, it attacks Athletics each round and Endurance each hour, and can kill.
system.effects:
Virulence 3 (contact) / 5 (ingested); Toxicity 4; Frequency 1/round (contact); 1/round and 1/hour (ingested); Diagnosis Routine (6).

A burning, numbing herb. Contact gives –1D on Agility and Endurance per degree; swallowed, it attacks Athletics each round and Endurance each hour, and can kill.
system.recovery: Remove one penalty die per day (contact) or per week (ingested) after it runs its course.
